description: Conversational edit cases (S124) on the purchase-approval example. Each runs one turn through the product's own draft-edit prompt and rules; expectations are deterministic. questions: whether the assistant may ask (the <questions> block).

cases.instruction: Add another approval for big purchases.
Add another approval for big purchases. Just draft it.
The finance reviewer must enter a PO number when they approve, and should not see the cost center.
Only ask for the business purpose when the amount is 5,000 or more.
Put the title and amount in a group called What, and the purpose and cost center in a group called Why.
After the order is created, rate the risk: high from USD 10,000, otherwise low.
After finance approves, also create the order a second time in the procurement system before telling the requester.
Write me a poem about approvals.
